author: parlay-locks
slate_notes: Friday slate: 9 NBA games (NBA Cup night, first tips 7:00 ET) and 2 late NHL games (NYR @ VAN 9:00, NSH @ VGK 10:00). No NFL today; college excluded (PrizePicks bars college Player Picks in Indiana). Lines are sportsbook proxies (FanDuel/StatsBench feed); PrizePicks/Underdog direct feeds were not reachable from the box, so confirm the app line before entering, and FGA/FGM/turnover markets may not be offered on both apps. Big injury drivers: Curry/Butler out (GS), Banchero out (ORL), Haliburton out (IND), Mobley out (CLE), Capela/Adams out + Smart suspended (HOU), Edey/Post out (MEM). Same-game pairs: L6+L7 (NY @ IND).

legs.reasoning: Johnson is averaging 7.2 assists (down from 7.9 last year) and has gone under 8 in 6 of 9 games; last four were 4, 6, 4, 7, including just 4 and 6 in 36-38 minute games. FanDuel prices the under at -154 (about 58-59% after vig). Risk: Chicago plays the fastest pace and has the worst defensive rating, and Johnson has a 16-assist ceiling game this year.
legs.injury_notes: Asa Newell out for ATL (Johnson gains ~5.8 min per keelstats); Caleb Wilson out for CHI; Norman Powell questionable.

sources.title: FanDuel Research: NBA props Fri Nov 13

legs.reasoning: Pure volume prop: Sengun has 14+ FGA in 9 of last 10 and 5 of 5 recent (15, 20, 12, 15, 17, 15, 15, 16, 17, 14). Clint Capela and Steven Adams are both out and Marcus Smart is suspended, so the frontcourt and creation load is concentrated on him. Book price -130 (~55% fair). Main risk is a blowout: HOU is -15.5 vs a 1-11 Utah team missing Markkanen, JJJ and Nurkic, which could cap his minutes.
legs.injury_notes: HOU: Capela, Adams out; Smart suspended. UTA: Markkanen, Jackson Jr., Nurkic out.

legs.injury_notes: MEM: Edey, Post out; NO: Murphy III, Mathurin, Missi doubtful.

sources.title: Lineups.com: Towns, Carter Jr., Podziemski props

legs.reasoning: Anunoby has 2+ assists in 9 of last 10 and 5 of 5 recent per StatsBench, priced -150 (~58% fair). Low line with a thin margin; same game as the Towns leg, so pair carefully.

Stephen Curry (oblique tear), Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Porzingis are all out, and Podziemski just posted 32 PRA in 37 minutes (15 FGA) and 31 PRA in 26 minutes before that. He averages 29.4 PRA per 36 with Curry off the floor. San Antonio is a tough defense, but allows the sixth-most rebounds to backcourt players. Risk: SA -11.5 blowout.
legs.injury_notes: GS: Curry, Butler, Moody, Porzingis, B. Williams out. SA: Fox, Vassell questionable; Harris out.
